name: Anbernic RG351P
identify: helperFunctions.sh: /proc/cpuinfo part 0xd04 (RK3326) + /etc/os-release OS_NAME=DARKMOSS, SPRUCE_PLATFORM=RG351P (stamped by dArkMoss's rg351p unit)

pad.note: an internal USB HID pad (1209:3100) behind a 05e3:0608 hub, not a kernel platform pad driver: no fixed by-path link, RG351P.cfg finds it by name; d-pad on a hat

power.from: derived: RG351P.cfg comment; not captured on hardware

L3.note: left stick click; no Menu button: whichever stick click Button Settings > Menu button selects (L3 by default, or R3) is MENU, and RG351P.cfg sets that click's B_L3/B_R3 to DOESNT_EXIST because the kernel autorepeats the HID pad and a held click's repeats would cancel its own menu press
L3.cfg_differs: B_L3 is DOESNT_EXIST under the default Menu button = L3 setting (the click is B_MENU then); the click itself sends 1 312

R3.note: right stick click; no Menu button: whichever stick click Button Settings > Menu button selects (L3 by default, or R3) is MENU, and RG351P.cfg sets that click's B_L3/B_R3 to DOESNT_EXIST because the kernel autorepeats the HID pad and a held click's repeats would cancel its own menu press
R3.cfg_differs: B_R3 is DOESNT_EXIST when Button Settings > Menu button is R3 (the click is B_MENU then); the click itself sends 1 313

absent.MENU: no Menu button: RG351P.cfg's B_MENU reuses L3's code (1 312) by default, or R3's (1 313) when Button Settings > Menu button is R3; SELECT+START also opens the PyUI menu
absent.VOL_UP: no volume key: volume is a hardware wheel after the rk817 codec; the cfg's B_VOLUP=1 115 is a placeholder nothing reports (kept so buttons_watchdog.sh makes no SELECT+click volume chords)
absent.VOL_DOWN: no volume key: volume is a hardware wheel after the rk817 codec; the cfg's B_VOLDOWN=1 114 is a placeholder nothing reports (kept so buttons_watchdog.sh makes no SELECT+click volume chords)

notes: No dedicated MENU button: by default the left stick click (1 312) is MENU (Button Settings > Menu button, default L3) and RG351P.cfg sets B_L3=DOESNT_EXIST; set to R3, the right stick click (1 313) is MENU and B_R3=DOESNT_EXIST instead. The L3/R3 steps expect the click's own code either way. SELECT+START also opens the PyUI menu.
No volume keys: the volume wheel works in hardware after the codec and sends no input event; spruce keeps the codec at full (RG351P.sh's set_volume).
Button codes come from ArkOS's RG351P EmulationStation config (es_input.cfg), per RG351P.cfg's header, not from a Button Reader capture on this device.
